scientific_integrity: The proof is analytic. Finite diagnostics are reproducibility checks, not infinite-domain verification. Publication priority and mathematics have not been independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Optimization is only for stationary-renewal-phase occupation with T in {1,2,3,4}, E[T]=3, localized coin s_ell, positive loop weight and full-state independent restarts. No unrestricted waiting-time, synchronized-clock-limit or monitored first-detection claim. Generic renewal identities and model definitions are prior work; broader unlocated priority risk remains.
title: Reentrant fixed-budget restart control in a three-state quantum walk
